claims.claim_text: The Calcasieu Pass LNG export terminal is a real, operational EPA-permitted major industrial facility in Cameron Parish, Louisiana, that commenced LNG production in 2022.
claims.subject: Venture Global / Calcasieu Pass
claims.object_value: Calcasieu Pass LNG terminal, Cameron Parish LA, operational since 2022
claims.source_quote: On March 1, 2022, we announced the successful loading and departure of our first cargo of LNG at the Calcasieu Project and all 18 liquefaction trains at the Calcasieu Project were capable of producing initial quantities of LNG by June 2022.

claims.claim_text: The Plaquemines LNG terminal is a real EPA-permitted major facility under construction in Plaquemines Parish, Louisiana.
claims.subject: Venture Global / Plaquemines
claims.object_value: Plaquemines LNG terminal, Plaquemines Parish LA
claims.source_quote: We currently estimate that the total project costs for the Plaquemines Project will be approximately $22.5 billion to $23.5 billion ... approximately $17.7 billion had been paid for as of September 30, 2024.

claims.claim_text: Calcasieu Pass generated approximately $19.6 billion in gross proceeds from 342 LNG commissioning cargos sold by Sept 30, 2024, reflecting substantial commercial LNG sales.
claims.subject: Venture Global
claims.source_quote: As of September 30, 2024, we had loaded and sold 342 LNG commissioning cargos and earned approximately $19.6 billion in gross proceeds from such sales.

claims.claim_text: Venture Global has long-term 20-year SPAs (offtake agreements) with named major counterparties including Shell and BP for LNG offtake from its terminals.
claims.subject: Venture Global
claims.predicate: has executed long-term SPAs with named offtakers
claims.object_value: SPAs with Shell, BP, and other offtakers
claims.source_quote: our dependence upon the performance by a limited number of our customers ... post-COD SPAs

claims.claim_text: Venture Global is involved in ongoing arbitration / legal disputes with its customers (offtakers) over the Calcasieu Pass project.
claims.subject: Venture Global
claims.object_value: disputes with customers, contractor damages up to ~$200M reasonably possible
claims.source_quote: Contingencies where losses are reasonably possible primarily relate to disputes with contractors ... See Note 4 Revenue from Contracts with Customers, for further discussion of the disputes with customers.

claims.claim_text: Venture Global has entered into shipbuilding agreements for five LNG tankers with deliveries beginning July 2025.
claims.subject: Venture Global
claims.source_quote: The Company has entered into shipbuilding agreements for the construction of five LNG tankers ... deliveries beginning in July 2025.

claims.claim_text: Venture Global's CP2, CP3 and Delta projects are forward LNG projects that as of Sept 30, 2024 have no executed EPC contracts (CP3/Delta) and no debt or equity financing obtained.
claims.subject: Venture Global
claims.predicate: has pre-FID forward projects without financing
claims.source_quote: As of September 30, 2024, no financing (equity nor debt) has been obtained for the CP2 Project, the CP3 Project, or the Delta Project.
